_comment: Name signals for NSFW-leaning image checkpoints. This is a LABEL, not a content gate — no judgment. Its ONLY effect on routing is AUTO-PICK: when a request does not name a model, dyva prefers a non-NSFW checkpoint, so 'a cute puppy' doesn't land on a model that emits a nude almost regardless of the prompt. An explicitly-named model is ALWAYS honored (want NSFW? name one). Case-insensitive regex matched against the checkpoint's base filename. Curate freely — the mechanism is the point, the list is tunable.
